headline: ROBOT LAB puts SimReady data to work
lede: Stage 2 of the robot sim kit (#1141): every physical part now carries its real-world record — supplier, license gate, mass and friction — and the cannon world actually runs on those transcribed numbers. Provenance is on screen, and every episode pins the physics revision it was played against.

notes.text: SimReady manifest (6 entities, link-only, CI never downloads) drives live masses/frictions: 1.6 kg drawer, 0.9 kg door, cardboard and tin surfaces from the asset records; autopilot still wins all six goals on 12 seeds.
robokitcheck grew to 10 gates — manifest schema, license-gate recompute, live-physics fidelity, episode asset pinning — with two mutants proven red then restored.

Caught a shipped stage-1 bug with a screenshot: PauseOverlay ignores its visible prop, so live play had worn the help screen. Fixed; the trap is now in GAME-SHELL.md — state probes stayed green the whole time, pixels didn't.
QA polish pass filed (#1227): wrist cam, prop realism vs provenance strip, latch/drawer audio juice, phone HUD density.
